"""Finding the stretches of opening hours that nobody covers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from hourglass.parsing import format_span
from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.merging import merge_spans
from hourglass.errors import ProjectError


def _gap_label(begin: int, stop: int) -> str:
    return f"gap {format_span(Span(begin, stop))} ({stop - begin} min)"


def _check_inside(worked: Iterable[Span], opening: Span) -> None:
    for span in worked:
        if span.start < opening.start or span.end > opening.end:
            raise ProjectError(f"{format_span(span)} is outside {format_span(opening)}")


# ---
def find_gaps(worked: Iterable[Span], opening: Span) -> List[str]:
    """One label per uncovered stretch of opening hours, in time order."""
    worked = list(worked)
    _check_inside(worked, opening)
    merged = merge_spans(worked)
    starts = [opening.start] + [span.end for span in merged]
    stops = [span.start for span in merged] + [opening.end]
    return [_gap_label(begin, stop) for begin, stop in zip(starts, stops) if begin < stop]

import unittest

from hourglass.models import Span
from hourglass.gaps import find_gaps
from hourglass.errors import ProjectError

OPEN = Span(540, 1020)


class FindGapsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_in_the_middle(self):
        worked = [Span(540, 720), Span(780, 1020)]
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps(worked, OPEN), ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_gaps_at_both_ends(self):
        labels = find_gaps([Span(600, 960)], OPEN)
        self.assertEqual(labels, ["gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)", "gap 16:00-17:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_nobody_working_is_one_big_gap(self):
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps([], OPEN), ["gap 09:00-17:00 (480 min)"])

    def test_overlaps_and_full_cover_leave_no_gap(self):
        worked = [Span(540, 800), Span(700, 1020)]
        self.assertEqual(find_gaps(worked, OPEN), [])

    def test_span_outside_opening_hours_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            find_gaps([Span(500, 600)], OPEN)
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            find_gaps([Span(900, 1100)], OPEN)
